about_the_game:
DESCRIPTION :
Inferis: Dead Below is a first-person psychological horror and walking simulator experience, offering approximately 45 to 50 minutes of intense gameplay.



Story Overview:
Journalist Larry descends into the underground tunnels, following the pleas of families who haven’t heard from their missing loved ones for a long time. Initially setting out to fulfill his duty as a reporter, Larry is soon pulled into a nightmare that tests both his mental and physical limits. As the line between reality and hallucination blurs, he finds himself edging closer to a dark secret that no human mind should ever uncover. The journey becomes not only a mission to uncover the truth—but a fight to save his own soul.

Game Features:

  • Immersive First-Person Experience: Step into the darkness through Larry’s eyes and explore a terrifying underground world.

  • Psychological Horror: A unique narrative where the boundaries of reality blur and mental collapse feels imminent.

  • Atmospheric Sound Design: High-quality audio and ambient effects that keep players on edge at all times.

  • Heavy and Claustrophobic Atmosphere: A tension-filled world shaped by fear of tight spaces and the unknown.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains scenes of blood, gore, and disturbing imagery that may not be suitable for all players.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600 / Intel Core i5 9400F
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 MB available space

short_description: You're a journalist searching for answers... but beneath the surface lies only terror. The labyrinth you’ve entered to find the missing may never let you leave.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Indonesian, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish, Greek
*languages with full audio support
